text:
Initial cookies: 9 oatmeal + 4 chocolate chip + 5 sugar = 18 cookies.
Ate 3 cookies (one of each): 18 - 3 = 15 cookies.
Ate 2 oatmeal cookies: 15 - 2 = 13 cookies.
Gave 2 sugar cookies to friends: 13 - 2 = 11 cookies.
Baked 4 of each flavor (4 × 3 = 12 cookies): 11 + 12 = 23 cookies.

ANSWER: 23
